unit: H148 - credit notes on a closed bill: medicine brought back after closing

Medicine brought back after the bill clo.ar: دواء أُرجع بعد إغلاق الفاتورة: تبقى الفاتورة كما رُحّلت، ويقل ما على المريض بهذا القدر.
Medicine brought back after the bill clo.en: Medicine brought back after the bill closed: the bill stays as posted, the patient owes this much less.
Medicine brought back after the bill clo.fr: Médicament rapporté après la clôture de la facture : la facture reste telle que comptabilisée, le patient doit d'autant moins.

The bill was closed in a foreign currenc.ar: أُغلقت الفاتورة بعملة أجنبية: سوِّ هذا المرتجع من الفوترة
The bill was closed in a foreign currenc.en: The bill was closed in a foreign currency: settle this return at billing
The bill was closed in a foreign currenc.fr: La facture a été clôturée en devise étrangère : régularisez ce retour à la facturation

The insurer paid part of this medicine:.ar: دفعت شركة التأمين جزءًا من هذا الدواء: صحّحه من خلال مطالبة التأمين
The insurer paid part of this medicine:.en: The insurer paid part of this medicine: correct it through the insurance claim
The insurer paid part of this medicine:.fr: L'assureur a payé une partie de ce médicament : corrigez-le via la demande de remboursement
